Build family group models with per-family relatedness matrices

Source: R/buildmxPedigrees.R
buildFamilyGroups_list.Rd

This function constructs OpenMx models for multiple family groups, each with its own relatedness matrices, observed IDs, and (for temporal models) birth years / historical moderators. Use this when families vary in size or structure; for families that all share the same relatedness matrices, see buildFamilyGroups.

Usage

buildFamilyGroups_list(
  dat_list,
  obs_ids_list,
  Addmat_list = NULL,
  Nucmat_list = NULL,
  Extmat_list = NULL,
  Mtdmat_list = NULL,
  Amimat_list = NULL,
  Dmgmat_list = NULL,
  prefix = "fam",
  condenseMatrixSlots = TRUE,
  temporal = FALSE,
  param_year_list = NULL,
  H_list = NULL,
  use_exp_loadings = TRUE,
  time_point_max = NULL,
  retain_eta = TRUE,
  retain_loadings = TRUE,
  retain_loading_covariances = TRUE,
  retain_component_covariances = TRUE,
  residual_covariance_form = c("outer_product", "diagonal"),
  clean_ids = TRUE
)

Arguments

dat_list

A list of numeric vectors of observed data, one per family.

obs_ids_list

A list of character vectors of individual IDs, one per family, matching dat_list and the rows/columns of that family's relatedness matrices.

Addmat_list

A list of additive genetic relatedness matrices, one per family.

Nucmat_list

A list of nuclear family shared environment relatedness matrices, one per family.

Extmat_list

A list of common extended family environment relatedness matrices, one per family.

Mtdmat_list

A list of mitochondrial genetic relatedness matrices, one per family.

Amimat_list

A list of additive by mitochondrial interaction relatedness matrices, one per family.

Dmgmat_list

A list of dominance genetic relatedness matrices, one per family.

prefix

A prefix for naming the family groups. Default is "fam".

condenseMatrixSlots

Logical. If TRUE, use the mxCondenseMatrixSlots wrapper to optimize memory usage for large matrices. Default is TRUE.

temporal

Logical. If TRUE, build a time-varying family-group model where each component's weight is a function of param_year (and, optionally, H) instead of a fixed scalar. Default is FALSE.

param_year_list

A list of numeric birth-year vectors, one per family, each matching the corresponding entry of obs_ids_list. Only used when temporal = TRUE.

H_list

A list of historical-moderator matrices, one per family. Only used when temporal = TRUE.

use_exp_loadings

Logical. If TRUE (default), each component's loading is exponentiated so its implied variance stays positive. Only used when temporal = TRUE.

time_point_max

Integer degree of the polynomial birth-year basis. Only used when temporal = TRUE. Default is 3.

retain_eta

Logical. Retain named temporal linear predictors Eta_*.

retain_loadings

Logical. Retain named loading vectors L_*.

retain_loading_covariances

Logical. Retain named loading outer products K*.

retain_component_covariances

Logical. Retain named relatedness-weighted component covariance algebras Cov_*. Any unretained layer is inlined, leaving V and the likelihood unchanged.

residual_covariance_form

Character. Use "outer_product" to preserve the original I * K_e representation or "diagonal" for the exactly equivalent vec2diag(L_e * L_e) representation.

clean_ids

Logical. If TRUE, clean the obs_ids to be syntactically valid R names using make.names. Default is FALSE.

Value

A list of OpenMx models for each family group.
